g.title: j2159084883
g.text: is everything creepy in the future?

g.title: j527782493
g.text: Mostly.

g.title: j3650609443
g.text: Not everything. Just stuff that the Entrati family deals with.

g.title: j2820693107
g.text: and i was so excited for a big cool mechsuit :(

g.title: j66379058
g.text: should have known entrati had something to do w/ that thing

g.title: j4046943000
g.text: is there a version that comes without an ugly gross skull stuck to the front?

g.title: j2071712527
g.text: i can't even enjoy a big cool mechsuit without him ruining it :(

g.title: j2893574493
g.text: I like the skull...

g.title: j258358913
g.text: Not that I know of.

g.title: j4129864746
g.text: Now that you mention it, I don't know what the skull *does.* But it has to be important.

g.title: j3542004723
g.text: Different Entrati, but I get your point.

g.title: j3473300272
g.text: Well, these were Father Entrati's creations, not Albrecht's, to be fair.

g.title: j4126715000
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_TWOHUGS>

g.text: mebbe i can start working on my own. design my own aoimech

g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_WUT>

g.text: It's a long story.

g.text: whoaaaaa one of them was a priest?!?!?!

g.title: j3897061062
g.text: u do u!!

g.text: hexamech lolol

g.text: excuse me? u don't know what it does?

g.title: j496248198
g.text: LOL. No. Very much not a priest. It's a long story.

g.text: its just not for me, u know?

g.title: j1321664615
g.text: have it play music while it fights

g.title: j187212073
g.text: Someone gives me a big gun, I use the big gun. I don't get paid to ask questions.

g.title: j288195357
g.text: Well, every single necramech I've ever seen has one.

g.title: j58184687
g.text: amir would totally help

g.title: j844503461
g.text: <RETRO_EMOJI_GLARE>

g.text: So it has to be functional. Right?

g.title: j3631331762
g.text: Just be careful.

g.text: I'd like to help, too. :)

g.text: riiiiiight...

g.text: well, i want a big stompy mech without a skull, i think that'd be fun

g.text: I don't think I want to find out, do you?
